inference.development_amortization: report entire new development wall/CPU separately; do not equate request-only prices to full lifetime economics
inference.economic_scope: Sensitivity over predeclared prices, not calibrated user value; CE(U-lambda*measured cost), not CE(U)-lambda*mean cost
inference.failures: retain attempts and costs, no dropped outliers; any unavailable quality or cache identity mismatch blocks quality inference
inference.price_bands: nominal95 max-absolute-centered bootstrap over frozen finite grid; separate wall and CPU bands, no combined family claim

primary_families.quality_vs_reference: rawCE>0 AND success difference>=0, zero margin
primary_families.replacement_vs_old_feedback: rawCE and success differences>=-.005 AND mean wall difference<0

profile.request_endpoint: actual selected generation, public policy, lossless NPZ, append+fsync, same-open-descriptor exact readback and hash verification
profile.selected_feedback: preselected per seed as cached or compact; references an actually executed policy row, no extra N
